rappel_detail.anchor: slung webbing found in place; no bolts or chains. Inspect and back up
rappel_detail.station: Above the short, steep 20-ft 4th-class rock step just below the summit.
rappel_detail.notes: The one place that regularly gets a rope. Some parties also rappel from webbing at the edge of the summit ridge, making two; others downclimb both.

set.rappel_count_note: One or two short rappels, roughly 15-30 m, get parties down the crux step below the summit; the step itself is the one that is regularly rappelled. Everything else on the descent is downclimbed.
